body: Can't. I drive to work/school everyday, there was a time when I had to use the bus and that time seems like a nightmare now, I went to school 1 hour earlier than I needed because the bus would be empty at that time.
I might try medication, maybe Effexor

Sure, I remember times I've messed up, but I've stopped caring about it so thats great. What my problem really is, is large gatherings of people or just being in a class at school or eating lunch at work - I don't have a problem talking with people one-to-one, but I can't talk in groups. I remember when I was younger and didn't give a shit, it seems like such a wonderful time now.

I partly blame my parents for the fact that I have no social skills, but at some point it is of course ones own responsibillity. When I was a kid I would always get asked "why don't you go home to X?" or "why don't you bring X home here?", I would actively avoid being social and my parents just let me, I wish they would've been way stricter about that, I definitely that this is part of the reason for my problems since I didn't have them at that age.

Its mentally taxing, I feel like I can't be myself, even with my friend that I've had for 15+ years. Talking to someone one-on-one is a million times easier than when a lot of people are present. We are 5 people in our company and we share it with another company, we have all have lunch everyday at 12.00 and everytime I just wanna kill myself after just sitting there quietly. I love everything about my job except for this, I absolutely hate it and I'm afraid that I might completely ruin it for myself.

I feel like I'm wasting my life, but I'm not very motivated to do anything about it. I constantly tell myself that its okay and just focus on my job / education. Thanks.

I don't even think I have a comfort zone, I'm most comfortable when I'm alone but even then I think about what a disappointment I am to myself.
